dataset: NOAA CPC ENSO indices (ONI and RONI), ERSSTv6-based

definitions.oni: 3-month running mean of ERSST.v6 SST anomalies in the Nino 3.4 region (5N-5S, 120-170W), based on centered 30-year base periods updated every 5 years. Source: https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso/oni/v6/
definitions.roni: 3-month running mean of ERSST.v6 Nino 3.4 SST anomalies (1991-2020 base) with the tropical-mean (20N-20S) SST anomaly subtracted, then rescaled so its variance equals the original Nino 3.4 index. Per NWS Public Information Statement 26-05, RONI is used for official ENSO monitoring. Source: https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso/roni/
definitions.temporal_alignment: Each 3-month season is assigned to its centre month: DJF of year Y -> Jan Y (window Dec Y-1..Feb Y); NDJ of year Y -> Dec Y (window Nov Y..Jan Y+1).
definitions.caveat: CPC notes the most recent values may change for up to two months after first posting and should be treated as estimates.
definitions.version_check: oni.ascii.txt values were matched against CPC's ERSSTv6 ONI table (DJF 1950: file -1.32, v6 table -1.3, v5 table -1.5).
